content:
Dear Connections,

Glad to announce that I’ve successfully completed my one-month online internship with Lawful Legal.

It was a privilege to work with Lawful Legal as a Legal Writing Intern, where I had the opportunity to strengthen my skills in legal article writing, legal research, analysis of contemporary legal issues and case summarisation.

More than anything, this internship helped me start writing again, something I genuinely value in my journey as a law student. Every assignment was a learning experience and I’m grateful for the opportunity to grow both academically and professionally.

I’m also delighted to have received my Internship Completion Certificate along with a Letter of Recommendation, based on my performance, from Shivannsh Gaurrav, Founder of Lawful Legal.

Grateful for the experience, the learning and the growth. Looking forward to what comes next! 🌱⚖️

Here is the Link of my 6 Published Articles, Oh Yes, you heard it right ! 

6 Articles in a row.🧿

You can also go to their website https://lawfullegal.in and search my name, you'll get all the 6 Articles there.🌻

comment: Legal writing internships often create value beyond published articles—the ability to research, structure arguments, and simplify complex issues is what ultimately shapes strong legal professionals.
